results.title: Oil firms fail to invest despite strong profits – NESG
results.snippet: The report said, “Nigeria’s petroleum exports are shifting from crude towards refined products, consistent with the Dangote refinery reaching full operation. Sector growth has slowed sharply even though crude production has held steady. Firms are in the sector profitable, liquid and have good access to credit, but they are not investing. That weakness stands out in such a capital-intensive sector.
